title: Heterogeneous Stochastic Momentum ADMM for Distributed Nonconvex Composite Optimization
summary: This paper investigates the distributed stochastic nonconvex and nonsmooth composite optimization problem. Existing stochastic typically rely on uniform step size strictly bounded by global network parameters, such as the maximum node degree or spectral radius. This dependency creates a severe performance bottleneck, particularly in heterogeneous network topologies where the step size must be conservatively reduced to ensure stability.
